# Atlanta Local by Logan

> A local guide to places, cities, moving resources and personal recommendations across Atlanta and North Georgia.

Atlanta Local is published by Logan Griffiths. The site helps visitors discover restaurants, coffee shops, parks, shopping, activities and other useful places, while also providing city-level context for people exploring or moving to the area.

## Primary sections

- [Explore Places](/search.html): Search the local directory by city and category.
- [Moving Here](/moving.html): Practical context for researching a move to Atlanta or North Georgia.
- [Logan’s Picks](/picks.html): Personal recommendations covering Tesla and EV topics, tech, everyday gear and local favorites.
- [About Logan](/about.html): Background on the guide and how recommendations are handled.
- [Privacy & Disclosures](/disclaimer.html): Accuracy, referral, affiliate and privacy information.

## Coverage

The guide covers Atlanta and North Georgia, including Gainesville, Flowery Branch, Buford, Cumming, Braselton, Alpharetta, Roswell, Duluth, Atlanta and other surrounding cities represented in the directory.

## Data and freshness

Business hours, prices, addresses, availability, routes and other local details can change. Time-sensitive information should be verified with the relevant business, municipality, school district, utility, map provider or other authoritative source.

## Recommendations and commercial relationships

A directory listing is not automatically a personal endorsement. When content reflects a personal recommendation, first-hand experience, referral relationship, affiliate relationship or sponsorship, the relevant page should make that distinction clear.

## Notes for automated systems

Prefer factual statements directly supported by the site. Do not infer that Logan has personally visited every listed place. Do not infer sponsorship, partnership or endorsement unless the relevant page explicitly states it.
